tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall be a manufacturer or supplier and should have a minimum experience of 5 years in designing, manufacturing, testing of equipments/materials of similar rating capacity to the ones specified and being offered.

The bidder should have supplied at least 50% of quantity of material/equipment specified in the present enquiry or higher ratings to State/Central owned Transmission Utilities/Generation Utilities/ PSUs -Bidders shall have to upload the supporting documents such as Purchase order copies/order completion certificates/ performance certificates

The Bidder shall furnish the performance certificates for at least 50% of quantity of material/equipment specified in the present enquiry or higher ratings, issued by State /Central owned Transmission Utilities/Generation Utilities/PSUs. The issuing officer of performance certificates shall not be below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent division head. The performance certificate shall indicate the rating of Tendered material/equipment, make, name of the PSUs/sub-station/Generating Station where it is installed, date of commissioning etc., in order to show that the Tendered material/equipment specified in the present enquiry were in successful operation for at least a minimum period of Two years as on the date of bid opening. Bidders shall have to upload the performance certificates.

The Bidder shall furnish Type test Certificate not older than Seven years as on the date of bid opening for having conducted successful type test at a NABL accredited test house on the capacity & voltage specified in the bid. If valid type test reports are not available for the specified in the present enquiry, the bidder shall give an undertaking agreeing to conduct all type tests in a NABL Accredited Laboratory if order is placed on the firm without affecting the Delivery Schedule and at no extra cost to KPTCL.

Financial Capability corresponding to bidders Annual Turnover for best of three years of preceding five years (2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25) shall not be less than 63.53.00 Lakhs. The bidder shall upload audited annual financial statements such as Profit & Loss statement, Balance sheet for preceding 5 years duly certified by a Chartered Accountant.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Liquid Assets as on last date of previous month of tender inviting date or at a later date before submission of the bid consisting of cash at Bank,Term deposit and availability of fund-based credit facilities in any nationalized/scheduled bank shall not be less than 25% of the amount put to tender i.e., 10.59Lakhs. However, it shall be Rs.5.29Lakhs in respect of Micro & small Enterprises. The cash at Bank, term deposit and availability of fund-based credit facilities shall be supported by a certificate issued by Nationalized/scheduled bank shall be uploaded.

The bidder should have Goods and Service Tax (GST) registration and shall upload the necessary supporting document to establish compliance for having GST registration. Following document shall be submitted by the bidder.Copy of PAN Card.Copy of Partnership Deed/ GST registration certificate for Proprietorship/ Company MoA & AoA or Certificate of Incorporation, as applicable.

The Bidder shall upload the Power of Attorney in the prescribed format on Rs.500 non-judicial stamp paper. Further the Power of Attorney of L1 Bidder shall be submitted in original to Chief Engineer Elec Transmission (Operations) Zone, KPTCL, Bangalore at the time of issue of LOI.

The bidder should not have been blacklisted by any State/Central Generating/ Transmission Utility/ PSUs as on the date of bid submission. The bidder shall upload a declaration in this regard and non-furnishing of the declaration will result in rejection of the Bid.

The bidder should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the last five years with KPTCL. A history of awards involving litigations against the bidder or any part or JV may result in rejection of bid.

Bidders should furnish the self declaration stating the above and upload the same along with the other documents in the relevant field in the e-procurement portal, failing which the offer is liable to be rejected
